TELSetupPostflight

Closes the tool file associated with the telephone tool. 
pascal void TELSetupPostflight (short procID);
procID
The tool ID for the telephone tool being configured.
DESCRIPTION
The TELSetupPostflight function closes the tool file if it's not being used by any sessions. The tool ID is assigned for a telephone tool through the TELGetProcID function.
